text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: The world's a grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
… As one, somewhere,
hath proclaimed. Each soul must 
perform its part… thine company included?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Reciting the script as its plot unfolds,
enacting the tale… 
Aye, following fate's decree. And the stage,
it shall inevitably 
draw its curtain.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
…… Hark! Methinks the hour draws nigh. 
Everyone, let us commence our tale ——

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —— And thus, with hearts and bodies carried by angels, the two were bestowed with eternal life, and they lived happily in heaven.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
…… What do you suppose, Gimlet? 
Isn't it a splendid tale?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
… O' graceful spirit of shamrock. Indeed,
the plot was 
brimming with intrigue, but alas,
its conclusion didn't 
quite cater to my taste.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In the land of Emerald,
tales speak of many mysteries lurking. 
Within them,
there must surely exist the essence to
bestow upon me… the gift of inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Inspiration?
Hmm… something that might pique 
Gimlet's interest… Ah, it's not exactly a tale,
but…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Halloween is approaching,
is it not? Did you know it's believed 
to have its origins in the Irish festival
of Samhain?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Samhain is a celebration that has been
observed for over 2,000 years.
It signifies the end of summer 
and was initially associated with the
harvest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
During Samhain,
the boundary between our world and the 
Otherworld weakens,
prompting people to don costumes for 
protection against mischievous spirits.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
… This world and the Otherworld.
The deceased and the living… 
Spirits and humans… As Halloween ends,
a "farewell" —

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
……… Hehe……!! 
Hehehe…… Haha……… HAAAAHAHAHA――!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Could it be that… I have given you
inspiration?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Inspiration? No,
it's a divine revelation! 
Fine… no, my Goddess of Creation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—— Would you like to create a world with
me?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
—— Hey,
have you thought about our theme for this
year yet? 
We should decide on it soon, shouldn't we?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right!
It'll be here in no time. 
―― All Hooves'!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(At Tracen Academy,
a fan appreciation festival is held every 
spring and autumn.
The autumn one is commonly nicknamed 
the "All Hooves'" festival,
and it's akin to a cultural festival.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(A large-scale event led by the students…
In which case, 
being a student,
I should have a role to play as well.)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty hard work,
though. …If I suggested that we have 
a serious go at it,
do you think everyone'd help out?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Eek! Sh-She's staring at me…… Is she telling
me 
not to be so dependent?!
…I-I'll try my best～!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Haah… haah…! As you'd expect from a festival with such history… These past documents… they're so… heavy…!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Wha… um, well… I, uh… 
I'm sorry for being so weak～～～!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps,
I might not have a role to play…… 
In this All Hooves' Festival……)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Fine… Do you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you noticed me? Ahem, I've come 
to invite you, Kris! You see ——

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That being said! 
I, Fine Motion, Gimlet —

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
— Shakur, Tap,
and Kris are poised to grace the festival
stage 
with our theatrical performance!
Clap clap clap～!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Fyuuh! Awesome! What a darn tootin' fine group, I tell ya! This is gonna be a hootin' good time, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Quit actin' all cozy. …And hey,
what's with 
the intense stare-down, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —— How unexpected…… for you to be here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Mission — I've been chosen by Fine. So, I will follow… but.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I reckon, Kris, yer wonderin',
"What kinda 'mission' 
does Shakur got?", am I right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
But ya see,
her heart's way simpler than that.
This gal's 
motivation always boils down to that
"Highness"! Don't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I told you not to get too cozy. 
My motivation is always data. D-A-T-A!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I knew that,
so I conducted my research and gathered
data. 
She's an important friend,
and I wished for her to be a part of it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The importance of experimenting with a
variety of physical expressions,
parallels between theatrical and racing
settings, 
and so forth… I'm pleased I could be of
assistance♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I'll be!
Does that mean if I didn't put myself 
out there, you'd have tried to woo me too?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
It's a splendid opportunity to create
beautiful memories with all of you.
I had a few heartfelt words 
prepared for you as well!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a darn shame!
But gatherin' with friends, 
and with Gimlet's script to boot,
it's mighty temptin' 
to dive right on in!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —— Gimlet… writing a script?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! Our theater troupe,
"Fortuna's Ovation", 
is about to bring to life… Yes,
a "farewell"! Presenting: 
"The Tragedy of a Certain Mechanical
Doll"!
